cards.evidence: Listed on the Credit Cards page as 'Secured cards (VISA/ RuPay)': limit from Rs 25,000 or 90% of term deposit face value, with a lien on the deposit. Counted as one entry; it is offered on two networks.

cards.name: IB-RuPay-Classic Credit Card

cards.name: IND Youth Credit Card
cards.evidence: Listed on the Credit Cards page as designed for ages 18-29. Its MITC (https://indianbank.bank.in/documents/d/guest/mitc-youth-credit-card, created 30 Oct 2026) describes a Visa Platinum product with no joining fee.
